checks.details: Roadmap S1 declares features [F-001..F-006] and modules [M-001, M-007]. LLD scope_features and scope_modules match 1:1. Per-feature file coverage verified: F-001 Supplier → SupplierModel + SupplierRepository + SupplierService + suppliers router + SupplierCreate/Update/Read + SuppliersPage + SupplierForm; F-002..F-005 follow the same five-layer pattern; F-006 Design-Grade-Map adds DesignGradeMapModel + repository (with get_by_pair, list_active_by_design) + service + design-grade-map router + the additional list_grades_for_design endpoint mounted on /designs/{id}/grades per HLD DF-006. Backend layered chain (config → infrastructure → application → presentation → main.py) is acyclic per LLD dependency_graph_notes. Migration 0002_master_tables.py + seed_master_data.py present. No feature in roadmap[S1] is uncovered.

LLD declares 6 ORM models in backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/master.py (SupplierModel, StaffModel, DealerModel, GradeModel, TradingDesignModel, DesignGradeMapModel). schema.json contains exactly 6 corresponding entities (tbl_supplier_master, tbl_staff_master, tbl_dealer_master, tbl_grade_master, tbl_trading_design_master, tbl_design_grade_map). Every entity has hld_module ('M-001' for the 6 entities; migration 0002_master_tables owned by M-007 per schema.migrations). All FK relationships in tbl_design_grade_map are explicit (design_id → tbl_trading_design_master.design_id, grade_id → tbl_grade_master.grade_id); no implied FKs. created_at omission on tbl_grade_master and tbl_design_grade_map is documented in schema.json notes[] and matches the LLD frontend types (Grade and DesignGradeMap also omit created_at). UNIQUE constraints (grade_code, design_id+grade_id) match the LLD ORM (UniqueConstraint per LLD line 136) and the AC sources (AC-011, AC-016).

S1 features F-001..F-006 expose 19 acceptance criteria in prd.json (AC-001..AC-019). test_cases.json.coverage_matrix enumerates all 19 ACs and every entry has at least one TC id — minimum coverage per AC verified. ac_coverage_total = 19, test_total = 46. Every test_case has ac_ref pointing at a real AC. The 3 highest-risk invariants (AC-011 UNIQUE(grade_code), AC-016 UNIQUE(design_id,grade_id), AC-019 GET /designs/{id}/grades active-only) are tested at three layers — service (ConflictError/NotFoundError), DB (IntegrityError on direct INSERT), and HTTP (409/200 via FastAPI TestClient). All 15 edge / negative cases explicitly typed 'edge'. Framework specified per case (pytest=38, jest=8). No invented criteria — completeness_check.no_invented_test_cases = true.

All non-stdlib imports referenced by LLD files have deps_manifest entries: backend — fastapi (main+routers), uvicorn (main), SQLAlchemy (base/session/models/repositories), psycopg (session), alembic (migrations env+versions), pydantic (schemas/master), pydantic-settings + python-dotenv (config); pytest + pytest-asyncio + httpx (test scaffolds). Frontend — next (app/**), react (**.tsx), @tanstack/react-query (provider + admin pages), axios (api/client), react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers + zod (admin forms + master-schemas), lucide-react (admin layout + MasterDataTable). Service & env_vars present: PostgreSQL 16 declared with docker-compose setup; DATABASE_URL, DB_PASSWORD, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL marked required. Migration 0002_master_tables.py listed under migrations[]. Two warnings logged separately (do not block): (a) jest + @testing-library/react not in deps_manifest although test_cases.json declares 8 jest cases — to be added before /ases-test-impl S1; (b) integration tests (TC-018, TC-026, TC-033..038) require a separate test database — strategy (ephemeral container vs schema) should be settled in /ases-tasks. Neither affects LLD-source completeness, hence pass with warnings.

S1 is the first sprint per roadmap (sprints[0]); there is no prior LLD output to conflict with. context.json.completed_steps lists no previous sprint LLD ('lld:S1' is the only LLD entry). All files declared in this LLD are new — verified against the scaffold manifest: scaffold only created skeleton dirs and shadcn ui primitives, none of which the S1 LLD redefines.

warnings: deps_manifest does not list jest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, or @testing-library/user-event, although test_cases.json declares 8 jest cases (TC-039..046). Add these dev deps to the manifest (or to /ases-sprint-scaffold output) before /ases-test-impl S1, otherwise the frontend test cases will not be runnable.
